citation.authors: Akowuah GA, Sabbagh BA, Palanirajan VK, Chew YL et al
citation.journal: Journal of Complementary and Integrative Medicine

cited_by.title: Bush teas and herbal remedies (cerasee, bitter leaf) with medicines

record.population: Diabetic rats (4 groups of 6) and enzyme assays
record.design: Single-dose experiment of bitter leaf aqueous leaf extract with metformin
record.finding: Given with metformin, the extract changed metformin's pharmacokinetics (higher peak level, higher total exposure and longer half-life) and inhibited the liver enzymes CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 in the assay. The authors say this suggests potential herb-drug interactions.
record.note: Rats only, one dose; a signal worth a pharmacist check, not a measured human risk.
